NOT FOR RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION IN WHOLE OR IN PART IN OR INTO THE UNITED STATES, CANADA OR JAPAN.
Result of Retail Offer and Restoration of Trading

Savannah, the developer of the Barroso Lithium Project in Portugal, a 'Strategic Project' under the European Critical Raw Materials Act and Europe's largest spodumene lithium deposit, announced on 22 September 2026 the launch of a fundraising comprising a Placing and Subscription in conjunction with a Retail Offer.

The Company is pleased to announce that the Retail Offer successfully completed and closed at 5.00 p.m. on 24 September 2026 and that it has conditionally raised £2,192,628 in the Retail Offer through the issue of 39,865,966 new Ordinary Shares at the Issue Price of 5.5 pence per share.

As a result of the Retail Offer, substantial shareholders, AMG Lithium B.V. and Telmory LDA have subscribed for 8,937,380 and 5,741,429 additional Subscription Shares respectively to ensure their percentage shareholdings in the Company are maintained on completion of the Fundraise. Further subscriptions have also been received from other parties including £20,000 from Rick Anthon, the Company’s Chair, altogether resulting in 17,562,356 additional Subscription Shares, bringing the total number of Subscription Shares to 189,660,099 conditionally raising approximately £10,431,305 via the Subscription.

Following the close of the Placing, the Retail Offer and the Subscription, the Company has conditionally raised gross proceeds of £30,088,587 (US$40,225,384) at the Issue Price via the Fundraising. The Company will therefore be required to issue and allot a total of 547,065,215 new Ordinary Shares to satisfy the aggregate demand of the Fundraise.

Savannah's Chief Executive Officer, Emanuel Proença said: "The level of interest shown in the Fundraise by hundreds of new and existing private investors through the Retail Offer is great to see and all at Savannah are extremely grateful for this support. The diversity in our shareholder base, from large institutions to private shareholders, spread across multiple countries demonstrates the wide levels of interest that exist in the development of the Barroso Lithium Project. The Savannah team and I are committed to creating further value for all our shareholders through the delivery of this exciting Project.

"The US$2.9 million invested through the Retail Offer takes total gross proceeds from the Fundraise to US$40.2 million. These funds, coupled with our existing cash and short term treasuries, give Savannah reserves of over US$53.0 million providing the financial strength to move with even greater purpose towards the start of construction next year."

The 317,539,150 Placing Shares, together with the 189,660,099 Subscription Shares and the 39,865,966 Retail Offer Shares, will be admitted to trading on AIM on 28 September 2026 (“Admission”).
Capital Access Window and Restoration of Trading

As detailed in the Company's announcement of 21 September 2026, the Company entered a Capital Access Window at 7:30 a.m. BST on 21 September 2026, in order to reach a broader range of investors during the Fundraise.

Following the results of the Retail Offer, the Capital Access Window has now closed and normal trading in the Company's existing Ordinary Shares is expected to resume at 7:30 a.m. BST on 25 September 2026.
The Retail Offer Shares and additional Subscription Shares will be credited as fully paid and rank pari passu with the existing Ordinary Shares.

Application has been made to the London Stock Exchange for the 39,865,966 Retail Offer Shares and 189,660,099 Subscription Shares to be admitted to trading on AIM. Admission is expected to take place and dealings in the Shares are expected to commence at 8.00 a.m. on 28 September 2026, at which time it is also expected that the Shares will be enabled for settlement in CREST.

Immediately following Admission, the issued share capital of the Company is expected to comprise 3,122,514,914 Ordinary Shares. Each Ordinary Share has one voting right and no Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. From Admission, this figure may be used by Shareholders as the denominator for the calculation by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the FCA’s Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
